data.name: ButtonsDescription
data.value: Every variant, size and state of the button, with click counters that prove the events fire, plus the copy button and one busy state shared by the whole button family.

data.name: ButtonsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the button of the first preview.

data.name: ButtonsVariantDescription
data.value: What the button means: the colour follows the role, not taste.

data.name: ButtonsTypeDescription
data.value: Submit sends the surrounding form, Reset clears it, Button does neither.

data.name: ButtonsContentDescription
data.value: An icon-only button carries its name as an accessible label and a tooltip.

data.name: ButtonsDisabledDescription
data.value: The button no longer reacts and leaves the tab order.

data.name: ButtonsBusyDescription
data.value: A veil breathes over the button; it keeps its size and ignores clicks.

data.name: ButtonsBusyOnClickDescription
data.value: Each click simulates two seconds of work, the way a real save would.

data.name: ButtonsIconSquaresTitle
data.value: Icon only: square at every size

data.name: ButtonsStatesTitle
data.value: Variants by state: at rest, disabled, busy, icon only

data.name: ButtonsBusyFamilyTitle
data.value: One busy state across the button family

data.name: ButtonsInteractionNote
data.value: A browser cannot freeze :hover or :active. The page repaints the two rules of the package with the same tokens (the hover and press fills of the button): a comparison aid, not a state of the package.

data.name: SplitButtonsDescription
data.value: A main action and its alternatives in one menu. The last action chosen is shown under the preview.

data.name: SplitButtonsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the split button of the first preview.

data.name: SplitButtonsSizeDescription
data.value: Size parameter: the same three sizes as OmniButton, main part and menu part together.

data.name: SplitButtonsVariantDescription
data.value: Both halves take the colour of the variant; Secondary, its original look, is the default.

data.name: SplitButtonsDisabledDescription
data.value: Both halves stop reacting: neither the action nor the menu opens.

data.name: SplitButtonsBusyDescription
data.value: The button stays focusable but refuses the action and the menu.

data.name: SplitButtonsBusyOnClickDescription
data.value: The main action simulates two seconds of work.

data.name: SplitButtonsItemDisabledDescription
data.value: Disables the last entry of the menu, the deletion.

data.name: SplitButtonsMainTextDescription
data.value: The text of the main half of the button.

data.name: ToggleButtonsDescription
data.value: A button that stays pressed: its state is bound to a value and announced to assistive technologies.

data.name: ToggleButtonsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the toggle button of the first preview. There is no variant: the pressed state alone carries the meaning.

data.name: ToggleButtonsPressedDescription
data.value: The same value as the button: flip one, the other follows.

data.name: ToggleButtonsSizeDescription
data.value: Size parameter: the same three sizes as OmniButton; with an icon alone the button is square.

data.name: ToggleButtonsContentDescription
data.value: An icon-only toggle carries its name as an accessible label and a tooltip.

data.name: ToggleButtonsDisabledDescription
data.value: The button keeps its state but can no longer change it.

data.name: ToggleButtonsBusyDescription
data.value: A veil breathes over the button and clicks are ignored.

data.name: ToggleButtonsSizesTitle
data.value: Sizes, with a label and as an icon alone
